_comment: THUGPRO's changes to THUG2's own levels (TP-42 in README.md here; the user's decision 2026-10-21: compare THUG2's node data). Written by `node tools/thug2_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro`, never by hand except `enabled`: every entry is off until the user switches it on; `node tools/thug2_levels/thugpro_apply.ts` (and make_menu_level.ts) apply the switched-on entries through the data overlay (levels\<L>\<L>.qb / .col.xbx / .scn.xbx / _scripts.qb, scripts\game\Levels.qb), made from the user's THUG2 files - never the game's files. class: parity (online play with THUGPRO players: spawns, crowns, CTF, rails, kill zones, collision players touch, graffiti objects), visible (seen differently, nothing to stand on: gaps, vehicles, loose objects), single_player, cosmetic, none. `scripts` / `replace_scripts` / `geometry`: THUGPRO's own items BY REFERENCE (archive entry and CRC-32; read from the THUGPRO install when applied, never stored here). `edits`: tools/thug1_levels/hand_edits.ts's form (names, {float}, {vector}, {string}).
_source: THUGPRO's installed data\pre (thugpro_qb.prx's Levels.qb: per level its node array qb=, level_qb=, more_level_qbs, thugpro_col_pre / thugpro_scn_pre; thugpro_dynamic.qb's <L>_LevelChanges) against THUG2's Data\pre (<L>_scripts.prx, <L>col.prx, <L>scn.prx, qb_scripts.prx's Levels.qb)
